name: Fireball Mini
description: a cute walking 50 ml mini whisky bottle: a flat, flask-shaped glass bottle with rounded shoulders, filled with glowing amber-orange cinnamon whisky, a red ribbed screw cap, and a parchment-yellow label with scorched, burnt-looking edges and little red flame curls — the label is where its happy face is — plus small arms and legs
rules: the glass is drawn solid, NOT see-through: no background shows through the bottle anywhere
flat flask shape with rounded shoulders; amber-orange liquid; a light glass highlight
a red ribbed screw cap on top
a parchment-yellow label with scorched edges and red flame curls; NO words, letters or logos on it; the face is on the label
